title: chrysanthemum maritimum var. inodorum
intro: Chrysanthemum maritimum var. inodorum, commonly known as Sea Chrysanthemum, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Sea Chrysanthemum include its sedative and anti-anxiety effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds work together to provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, contributing to the plant's overall therapeutic potential.
